content:
pat: Quick thread — product wants a compact release note + migration microguide for the new routing opt-in. Target ship: 2026-05-05. Docs PR by 2026-04-30.

elena: I can draft. Any mandatory SDK version bumps?

brad: Eng: new flag is routing.prefer_latency (boolean). Default false. No SDK breaking changes, but recommend SDK >= v2.1.0 to use the routing param object shape. Known quirk: when fallback triggers during streaming, clients may observe a short partial chunk before the fallback response arrives.

jen: Draft changelog bullet: "Latency-first routing (opt-in): add routing.prefer_latency to prioritize latency-optimized model variants; opt-in only, existing behavior unchanged." Short and punchy.

elena: I'll add a micro-migration with JS and Go snippets plus a one-liner about prefix cache effects and a troubleshooting tip for support.

brad: Add cache note: enabling prefer_latency can route to different model families and reduce prefix/KV cache hit rate transiently; token-cost delta should normalize after warm-up.

jen: Support troubleshooting lines: - If you see partial streams: set retry_on_fallback: true or disable streaming during migration. - For deterministic output, keep prefer_latency:false.

elena: JS snippet (v2.1+):

```js
// JS SDK v2.1+
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({
  model: 'rwk-1',
  prompt: 'Summarize the PR',
  routing: { prefer_latency: true }
});
console.log(out.output_text || out.text);
```

elen a: Go snippet: (short)

```go
// Go SDK example
c := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
resp, _ := c.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateParams{
  Model: "rwk-1",
  Prompt: "Summarize the PR",
  Routing: map[string]any{"prefer_latency": true},
})
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

brad: tiny note: the Go SDK example uses a generic map for routing until v0.9 adds a typed RoutingOptions. We'll call that out in the migration guide.

docbot: Branch created: refs/heads/docs/latency-optin-may05 by elena (CI queued).

elena: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/558 — includes changelog entry, micro-migration anchor (/docs/migrate/latency-first), JS+Go snippets, cache note, and support tips. Tagging @brad for tech signoff and @jen for copy.

brad: Reviewing now. I'll add a one-line clarification on the partial chunk duration (typically <300ms) and mention that can be influenced by model spin-up latency.

jen: Copy tweak: change "Latency-first routing" -> "Latency-first (opt-in) routing" for clarity. Also add a 'See also' pointer to the rollout schedule.

elena: Added rollout note: gradual rollout over 72 hours with automated rollback on error thresholds; support will be notified post-merge.

release-bot: merge-ready checks passed (CI green).

elena: Merging after staging preview. I'll also append the changelog line to /docs/changelog/2026-05.md once merged.

pat: Thanks team — closing thread. Followups on the PR.
